claim: Predict an unseen exploration galaxy's rotation curve and a training-only G2 formula class from baryonic structure, without galaxy ID or held-out velocities. This is exploration-set model development, not confirmation or a universal gravity law.

whole_galaxy_cross_validation.assignment: sort galaxy names by sha256(salt|name), then assign sorted rank modulo the fold count

forbidden: G1 class label of heldout galaxy

learned_residual.shrinkage_selection: minimum aggregate chi-square on inner whole-galaxy out-of-fold predictions from the outer-training galaxies only; ties choose smaller alpha

formula_projection.library: G2 structural classes having at least one member galaxy in the outer-training partition
formula_projection.fit_target: the learned V_meta^2 prediction on heldout baryonic radii, never V_obs
formula_projection.coefficients: unweighted two-column least squares to the learned prediction
formula_projection.selection: minimum normalized squared projection error, ties by class ID
formula_projection.evaluation: the projected G2 formula and generated coefficients, not the unprojected ensemble curve

baselines.newtonian_baryons: V_bar from the heldout galaxy's baryonic inputs
baselines.constant_residual: outer-training median delta applied to every heldout radius
baselines.nearest_galaxy: nearest standardized baryonic-summary training galaxy; transfer its best G1 formula and median fold coefficients

decision.pass: the projected training-only G2 formulas clear every admission condition and beat every declared baseline by at least 0.5% aggregate chi-square
decision.block: any leakage or projection violation occurs, any galaxy lacks a prediction, or the projected meta-law misses any baseline gain
decision.after_pass: authorize G4 universal zero-local-constant law construction; do not open confirmation until that law is frozen
decision.after_block: retain fold counterexamples and return to G3 model generation without opening confirmation
